entry.title: Narrated app guides and working video playback
entry.summary: V23 preserves the Council workspace and publishes narrated app guides with captions, transcripts, reliable public routing and seekable playback.

changes.title: Three narrated app guides
changes.description: Real app recordings explain observation and planning, Council evidence, and reporting with recovery. Each includes narration, captions, a poster and a matching transcript.

changes.title: Public video playback and failure recovery
changes.description: The gateway serves the explainers directory with byte-range seeking. Video and transcript failures expose readable fallback states.

changes.title: Desktop and mobile walkthrough
changes.description: A 5:21 narrated side-by-side walkthrough is available in the GitHub output/demo-video folder.
